_meta.change: split the cogPG.PG158 whole-volume CGPG dump into per-work corpus files
_meta.plan_basis: cgpg_split_proposals.json PG158 (consistency review: ok). Credited tlg3047.002 (Annales lectiones variae) is not identifiable in the served text (its PG appendix falls in the unserved rows 348-358) and gets no range
_meta.reversible: To revert: for every carved work file listed under 'works', drop its rows whose locus starts 'PG158.' (delete the file when it was 'created'), strip the 'PG158.' prefix from their loci, re-insert them and the archived 'dropped_duplicates' rows into data/corpus/cogPG.PG158.jsonl together with the residual rows, sorted by locus, and restore data/cgpg_works.json, data/tlg_crosswalk.json/.tsv, and data/corrections_log/provenance.json from the parent commit (or simply git revert the commit; old sha256 below verifies). Every moved row's text is byte-identical; only urn and locus changed.
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary is assigned to exactly one work, normally the one whose incipit the row carries; the plan records the decision as the ranges themselves

corrections_mirror_note: data/corrections_log/applied.jsonl keys this volume's corrections by bare column locus under cogPG.PG158; per the rekey_corrections_log.py convention for cogPG.* bare-locus rows they are left unchanged (historical). The locus map above makes the linkage reconstructable.
